description: This file defines an abstract class 'TimesheetPeriod' within the 'OrangeHRM\Time\TimeSheetPeriod' namespace. It includes two abstract methods related to timesheet period management: setting the period and calculating days within the period.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriod
classes.description: An abstract class representing a timesheet period with methods to set the period and calculate days within the period.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Abstract method to set the timesheet period and start date, taking a start day as input.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate days in the timesheet period based on the current date and some XML data.
